items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I could probably name any member piano player. We played there. Almond Hook, Eddie Shields, Von Hecht, Mickey Markle, Ernest Bobby.

ctx.x: What about the Fern? What kind of numbers did you play at the Fern?

Well, the fine. Well, four minutes slow drag is, you know, the routine was this. Every fourth piece, everybody get a rest. The piano would play. The piano play. I could probably never play there. I could probably name any member piano player. We played there. Almond Hook, Eddie Shields, Von Hecht, Mickey Markle, Ernest Bobby. And we played. And we played. Walls just by itself. Just piano, see. And then now I stop. Four minutes slow drag. And we play. Ten rules. We can stop. We had the band. Yeah, the band. We had…
You want to, what happened, the routine at the Fern? You had those four minute slow drags on?
